gloss: to see through to the end; to witness; to make sure

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {見届|みとど}けませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {見届|みとど}けていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {見届|みとど}けていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to see through to the end; to witness the conclusion
definitions.explanation: To watch or observe something until it reaches its natural end or conclusion.

definitions.gloss: to make sure; to confirm; to ascertain
definitions.explanation: To verify or ensure that something is done or happens correctly.

examples.japanese: {最後|さいご}まで{試合|しあい}を{見届|みとど}けた。
examples.english: I watched the match through to the end.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}の{成長|せいちょう}を{見届|みとど}けたい。
examples.english: I want to see my son grow up.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{娘|むすめ}の{結婚式|けっこんしき}を{見届|みとど}けてから、{安心|あんしん}して{引退|いんたい}した。
examples.english: He retired with peace of mind after seeing his daughter's wedding.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}が{届|とど}いたか{見届|みとど}けてください。
examples.english: Please make sure the documents have arrived.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもが{無事|ぶじ}に{学校|がっこう}に{入|はい}るのを{見届|みとど}けた。
examples.english: I made sure the child got into school safely.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}が{無事|ぶじ}に{離陸|りりく}するのを{見届|みとど}けてから、{空港|くうこう}を{後|あと}にした。
examples.english: After making sure the plane took off safely, I left the airport.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
Pattern: [event/thing]を{見届|みとど}ける

ASPECT (ている):
{見届|みとど}けている can mean actively watching something or having confirmed something.

- {見届|みとど}けない (negative)
- {見届|みとど}けて (te-form)
- {見届|みとど}けた (past)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最後|さいご}まで{見届|みとど}ける - to see through to the very end
- {行|い}く{末|すえ}を{見届|みとど}ける - to see how things turn out
- {結果|けっか}を{見届|みとど}ける - to witness the result
- {無事|ぶじ}を{見届|みとど}ける - to confirm someone's safety

COMPOUND VERB:
{見|み} (see) + {届|とど}ける (to deliver/reach) → to see to completion
